items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: "Did you ever hear of Lionel Hampton?" And I'd say, "Sure, I did."

ctx.x: Well, the jokes we did. We continued doing the jokes. And we added like new jokes to the continuity, like say for instance, I said Chuckles began playing the vibraphone, you see? So somewhere along in there he would walk out of the spotlight and go and bring on the instrument, vibraphone. So when I look around and see him pushing it out of the wings onto the stage, and I'd ask him, I'd say, "Say, Chuckles, what's this you've got there?" He'd say, "These is vibraphones. I made them." I'd say, "You made them?" He'd…

I play them?" "Did you ever hear of Lionel Hampton?" And I'd say, "Sure, I did." Then I'd say, "What's his name?" He'd say, "Who?" And I'd say, "Lionel Hampton," and he said, "Never heard of him." And then he began to play, "Lady Be Good".
Did you dance to it when he played?
